BSShaderPPLightingProperty RenderPass-list producer and cache owner. In emit mode, a matching (renderMode<<8)|buildFlags key reuses the property-owned list; on a miss it clears the lists and dispatches virtual +0x98 for shader-package class 1 or +0x9C for class >=2. Conditional Hair reaches this function only when B42F3E is enabled and flags this+0x1C contain 0x8000/0x10000; class >=2 then completes Hair's path to the inherited high-selector producer. A later class>=3/feature-0x10 path can append a mode-5 caster.

SpeedTreeOBSE v160 recovery: plugin only invalidates the cache key on late static failure, without freeing pass records held by an accumulator. Next normal-mode emit query uses native dynamic producers; count-only queries do not mark a new published plan. Cache mismatch sentinel is requested flags XOR1 for normal mode0. Failed queued static color/fog records remain suppressed until the property has completed native emission. This is plugin recovery logic; full native runtime execution is UNVERIFIED.

Base PP-lighting vtable +0x5C render-pass builder. Stock accumulator reachability: BSShaderPPLightingProperty and both SpeedTree PP-lighting owners retain this slot; Lighting30 overrides +0x5C with 0x8637D0; Hair overrides it with 0x882AE0 and calls this only for Refract/RefractF fallback.
